content.json:
# 🛒 E-Commerce Service Health Dashboard

Real-time monitoring of all microservices in the Perfume & Dessert e-commerce platform.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(1h)
| summarize Requests = count(), Failures = countif(success == false)
| extend SuccessRate = round(100.0 * (Requests - Failures) / Requests, 1)
content.title: Overall Health

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > {TimeRange:query}
| summarize 
    Requests = count(),
    Failures = countif(success == false),
    AvgLatency = round(avg(duration), 0),
    P95Latency = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0)
    by Service = cloud_RoleName
| extend FailureRate = round(100.0 * Failures / Requests, 2)
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Service Performance

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > {TimeRange:query}
| summarize Count = count() by bin(timestamp, 5m), cloud_RoleName
| render timechart
content.title: Request Volume by Service

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > {TimeRange:query}
| summarize ErrorRate = 100.0 * countif(success == false) / count() by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: Error Rate Trend

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp > {TimeRange:query}
| summarize 
    Calls = count(),
    Failures = countif(success == false),
    AvgDuration = round(avg(duration), 0)
    by type, target
| extend FailureRate = round(100.0 * Failures / Calls, 2)
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Dependency Health

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp > {TimeRange:query}
| summarize Count = count() by type
| order by Count desc
| take 10
content.title: Top Exceptions
